主要内容: On February 20, 2019, Claire L. Arnold announced her intention to resign as a member of the Board of Directors of Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc., effective at the Company’s 2019 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Her resignation did not involve any disagreement with the Company on operational or policy matters. On February 21, 2019, the Board increased its size to nine members and appointed Deborah Borg as a director and member of the Compensation Committee, effective immediately. Ms. Borg will receive the Company’s standard compensation for non-employee directors, as outlined in the Company’s definitive proxy statement filed on April 26, 2018. She has no family ties to any director or executive officer and no prior arrangements for her appointment. Additionally, no transactions involving Ms. Borg require disclosure under Regulation S-K. The Compensation Committee also adopted the Annual Incentive Plan on February 20, 2019, which outlines performance-based compensation for executives.
